description: Check a token approval before signing it: reads the ERC-20 allowance (owner -> spender) live on Base and returns the raw allowance, an unlimited-approval flag and a risk verdict. Read-only, no keys, no transaction.

spender.description: Spender address whose allowance is checked.

token.description: ERC-20 token address. Defaults to USDC on Base.

name: approval-check
